literal: Difficult indeed is consolation, even in those who possess wisdom, because separation exists at a certain time.
translation: Consolation is indeed difficult to find, even in those who possess great wisdom, because separation is a reality that inevitably occurs at some time.
modern: அறிவுடையவர்களிடத்திலும் தேறுதல் அடைவது மிகவும் அரிதானது; ஏனெனில், ஏதோ ஒரு காலத்தில் பிரிவு என்பது உண்மையாகவே நிகழ்ந்துவிடுகிறது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the overwhelming pain of parting, which can shatter even the most disciplined minds. The speaker notes that finding consolation or clarity of mind (தேற்றம்) is extremely difficult (அரிது), even among highly wise and mature individuals (அறிவுடையார் கண்ணும்). This is because separation (பிரிவு) is an inevitable reality that occurs at some point (ஓர் இடத்து உண்மையான்). The verse beautifully shows that the emotional suffering of parting transcends intellectual wisdom and self-control.
